scripts.dev: npm run build -w @ashfall/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client "npm run watch -w @ashfall/shared" "npm run dev -w @ashfall/server" "npm run dev -w @ashfall/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ashfall/shared && npm run build -w @ashfall/server && npm run build -w @ashfall/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @ashfall/shared && tsc --noEmit -p apps/server && tsc --noEmit -p apps/client
